nodes.name: animation.rs
nodes.summary: Generic types for CSS animation and transition properties, including AnimationDuration, AnimationTimeline, ViewFunction, animation-range values, and ViewTimelineInset for scroll-driven animations.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses generic type parameters extensively to support both specified and computed value representations.

nodes.name: background.rs
nodes.summary: Generic type for the CSS background-size property, providing an enum with ExplicitSize, Cover, and Contain variants using generic LengthPercentageOrAuto for dimensions.

nodes.name: basic_shape.rs
nodes.summary: Generic types for CSS basic shapes and SVG path operations, implementing clip-path, shape-outside, inset rects, circles, ellipses, polygons, and path commands with animation support.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements complex animation logic via ToAnimatedValue derive macros and manual ComputeSquaredDistance.

nodes.name: calc.rs
nodes.summary: Generic CSS calc() value computation engine implementing a tree-based expression evaluator with simplification, sorting, operator precedence, and serialization for math expressions.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements a recursive tree-walking algorithm with visitor pattern for expression simplification and sorting.

nodes.name: color.rs
nodes.summary: Generic types for CSS color values including color-mix() function, light-dark() color scheme adaptation, caret-color, and color-or-auto variants with interpolation and mixing support.
